test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The police officer said to him, "Why were you out till late last night?"

options.text: The police officer asked him that why he were out till late the previous night
The police officer asked him why he had been out till late the previous night.
The police officer asked him why had he been out till late last night.
The police officer asked him why was he out till late last night.

solution:
The correct answer is '**The police officer asked him why he had been out till late the previous night.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is indirect speech. According to the question, we need to change it into indirect speech.
 
• The given speech is an interrogative sentence, where the police officer asks a question.
 
• The process of changing direct speech to its indirect form is as follows - 
 
 
• Since it is not a *yes-no question,*the reported speech will start with why.
 
• The reporting verb said is changed into asked or enquired. 
 
• The second person 'you' will be changed into he.
 
• The **past continuous tense **were changes to **past perfect continuous **had been in reported speech. 
 
• **'Last night' **becomes **'the previous night'**.
 
 
 
• ​Eventually, we will get the final sentence- The police officer asked him why he had been out till late the previous night.
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.
